ai_language_tip: 用清楚英語，開場 Good morning／afternoon 加 Sir 或 Madam。不要把南非的 Dineplan、Mr D 或 'now now' 口吻直接套進來。對方若夾本地語言詞，回覆仍用英語。
english_ok: yes — 英語是三國公務與多數店家用語；鄉鎮櫃台口音較重，但通常仍以英語溝通。
politeness: 先短問候再辦正事，對陌生人用 Sir／Madam 或 Please；熟了才直呼名字。結尾 Thank you, enjoy the rest of your day。
name_tip: 報名加姓（如 Chipo Ncube、Mutale Banda）；前綴姓與音譯名先用訂位已寫的拼法，再逐個字母拼。
phone_tip: 尚比亞、辛巴威國內手機連開頭 0 常寫成 10 位左右（097 123 4567、077 123 4567）；馬拉威常見 088 或 099 開頭。國際冠碼 +260 / +263 / +265。朗讀分組。
time_tip: 口語多用 12 小時加 am/pm，書面可見 18:30。晚餐多在 18:30–19:30，比南非許多都市略早。不要把寬鬆的 'just now' 當成準時。
number_tip: 金額先報該國貨幣（尚比亞克瓦查、辛巴威常用 EcoCash 餘額或當地貨幣、馬拉威克瓦查）。錢包品牌要跟著對方：EcoCash 主要在辛巴威，Mpamba 在馬拉威，尚比亞常見 Airtel Money 或 MTN MoMo。
avoid_calling: 避開 12:30–14:00 午餐與 18:30–20:00 晚餐高峰，以及週日上午打給辦公室與診所；平日 18:00 後少打給政府與技師。
closed_days: 獨立日與建國相關假期三國不同；耶誕、新年、勞動節常見。辛巴威公共假期以官方公告為準。週日許多市區店仍開，但機關多休息。
booking_channels: 電話與 WhatsApp 仍是主流。辛巴威有 Marii Tables（掃 QR、菜單與訂位，可付 EcoCash、InnBucks 等）；尚比亞有 Mesa、Cartlify 等經 WhatsApp 留桌並可付 MTN MoMo 或 Airtel Money。不要套用南非的 Dineplan。叫車在部分城市有本地或區域 App，小城仍靠電話約司機。
voice_menu: 銀行、Airtel／MTN／Econet 與 EcoCash 相關熱線常有語音選單；小館與多數診所直接接聽。
callback_habits: Marii 或 WhatsApp 工具會在訊息裡確認；小店回一句 WhatsApp。不要只依賴電子郵件，除非是國際旅館。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 哈拉雷可用 Marii Tables 留桌或點餐，路沙卡有 Mesa 等 WhatsApp 工具；其他城市多半直接打電話。不要用南非的 Dineplan 去套這三國。
usually_asked: Date and sitting (lunch around 12:30 vs dinner around 18:30–19:30)
Party size and whether a high chair is needed
Indoor, veranda or a garden table
Name and a local mobile in that country's 0-plus format
Whether they will pay EcoCash, Airtel Money, Mpamba or cash

may_come_up.what: A Marii QR booking already exists and should be used in Harare
Payment brand is country-specific: EcoCash in Zimbabwe, Mpamba in Malawi, Airtel Money or MTN MoMo in Zambia
The plot or compound security will ask for the guest's name at the gate

sensitive_asked.what: A transfer to an unlabelled personal EcoCash or Airtel Money number is demanded before the table is written down

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 私立診所用電話或 WhatsApp 掛號較常見，公立醫院常要到場取號；要問是否走醫療援助或現金。
usually_asked: First visit or follow-up and the specialty
Patient name as on a national ID or medical-aid card
Medical aid, cash or a company account

may_come_up.what: A public hospital may only issue numbers in person in the morning

sensitive_asked.what: A third party is asked to read out a full medical file on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 沙龍幾乎都用 WhatsApp 約時間，電話打通後也常被請傳造型與要做多久。
usually_asked: Hair, nails or barber work and a realistic duration
Date and hour plus a backup slot
The WhatsApp number for the reminder

may_come_up.what: A stylist works from a plot and is known mainly by a first name
An EcoCash or MoMo deposit is asked for a wedding booking

sensitive_asked.what: Identity photos are demanded in a private chat before any time is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車、發電機與冰箱維修先 WhatsApp 傳照片再約，電話只確認師傅能否上門或是否在廠。
usually_asked: What failed and the make (generator, fridge, vehicle)
Bring-in versus a visit at the plot or office
When someone will be at the gate

may_come_up.what: A part may have to come from Lusaka, Harare or Johannesburg and the delay is loose

sensitive_asked.what: A diagnostic fee is demanded to a personal EcoCash or Airtel Money account before the item is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶多用 WhatsApp 或電話；部分城市有本地外送，但不要假設有南非的 Mr D。送餐地址要寫 plot、stand 與 gate。
usually_asked: Dishes and portions, including relish or spice if it matters
Collection versus delivery to a named plot, stand or compound
A number the rider can call at the gate, plus a landmark

may_come_up.what: A courier may only cover a handful of suburbs in Lusaka, Harare or Lilongwe

sensitive_asked.what: The rider asks to be paid into a personal wallet that is not the restaurant's

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨靠 WhatsApp 對型號，較大超市才有網站；電話只確認庫存與取貨日。
usually_asked: Exact model, size and quantity
Collect in store versus a dispatch to another suburb
Name to write on the set-aside goods

may_come_up.what: The item is in a warehouse across town and will move the next working day

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private EcoCash or Airtel Money number is required before they confirm stock

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期回原 WhatsApp 或同一套 Marii／Mesa 對話，報名字與原時間即可。
usually_asked: Original day, hour and the name on the booking
The new slot or a cancellation
New headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A weekend table already took an EcoCash deposit

sensitive_asked.what: An extra wallet payment is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問是否營業、收哪一種錢包，直接打或傳 WhatsApp；不要用過時網頁上的電話當唯一依據。
usually_asked: The exact question (hours, EcoCash versus Airtel Money or Mpamba, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to come
A number for a later WhatsApp reply

may_come_up.what: The everyday wallet word changes by country and should follow the shop

sensitive_asked.what: A stranger asks the owner to read an EcoCash PIN or SMS token aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 都市旅館可用 Booking.com 或官網，賓館與度假小屋多用 WhatsApp 問空房；入住常要出示證件。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and the number of guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the ID or passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A lodge may mention generator or borehole hours

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan plus a transfer to a personal wallet is demanded before confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 瀑布、湖區與國家公園行程多經旅行社或旅館櫃檯預訂，常有最低人數與公園門票規則。
usually_asked: Which excursion and the date, with a weather backup
Adults and children and the pickup (hotel or lodge)
A mobile that will work on the road

may_come_up.what: A park fee may be cash-only at the gate
The vehicle leaves only with a minimum group

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、發電機與清潔靠 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要寫 plot 或 stand 號碼，並說明 gate 怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The job and a visit window
Plot or stand, suburb and how to pass the gate
A number that will answer security or the occupant

may_come_up.what: The technician quotes only after a WhatsApp photo or a short inspection

sensitive_asked.what: A gate code and a remote wallet payment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 都市獸醫可電話或 WhatsApp 預約，其他地方常是上午到場；要說明動物種類與疫苗。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
First visit or a booster
Owner name and a reachable mobile

may_come_up.what: Boarding may need a vaccination card

sensitive_asked.what: A personal wallet payment is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 國內巴士託運與從倉庫取件常要打電話或 WhatsApp，單號加上城市與 plot 名稱較有用。
usually_asked: Waybill and the destination city (Lusaka, Harare, Lilongwe, Blantyre…)
Name on the parcel and a local contact
Depot collection versus delivery to a named plot

may_come_up.what: A cash-on-delivery balance may be due in the local currency

sensitive_asked.what: A wallet top-up is requested to release an unidentified parcel

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行、Econet／Airtel／MTN 與 EcoCash 客服多半先入語音選單；備妥錢包或帳號，不要在電話裡報 PIN。
usually_asked: Which bank or operator and the account, SIM or wallet label
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: They may send the customer to a shop or agency with a valid ID

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for an EcoCash, Airtel Money or Mpamba PIN or SMS code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 部分都市可用本地或區域叫車 App，不必先打電話；小城與機場接送仍多用 WhatsApp 約熟司機或旅館代叫。不要假設有 Uber 覆蓋。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (plot, hotel, airport, lodge) and the time
Passengers and bags
A number the driver can call at the gate

may_come_up.what: An app may already cover the city, so a phone dispatch is unnecessary there

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal EcoCash or Airtel Money number before sharing a plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介 WhatsApp 約，地址用 plot 或 stand 與郊區名；可能被要求先出示證件。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent or sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget in the local currency if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see an ID before opening a furnished house
Levies or borehole charges may be separate from the advertised rent

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal wallet is demanded before any accompanied visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公家單位與學校窗口常要本人取號，電話多只能問文件與開放時間；語氣保持正式。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose
The person's name as on a national ID or passport
Whether a ticket is issued only in person and from which hour

may_come_up.what: Many counters close around midday or on a public holiday that differs by country

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from an office asks for a personal wallet payment to speed up a file
